svg.title: Wiring an ESP32 to the Wayzn WYP-BC-100 board
svg.text: Wiring the ESP32 to the Wayzn board (WYP-BC-100 Rev 2.6, component side)
Traced from photos/2026-11-20_bench_stm-imp-connectors.jpeg, roughly to scale. The board continues to the left (motor and 12 V end).
IMP_RST (SW1): top-right pad to bottom-left pad, on the board — holds the imp004m in reset so it never drives the bus
header TX = STM32 TX, into the ESP32 (its UART RX)
header RX = STM32 RX, driven by the ESP32 (its UART TX)
Power: the ESP32 runs from the board's 3V3 (header pin) into its 3V3 pin, not VIN.
Never connect the ESP32's USB while the 3V3 wire is connected. The board's pull-ups serve the I2C bus.
GPIO27 drives NRST open-drain (pulled low briefly): the STM32 doesn't always start on a cold power-up.
